manifest_text:
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=77"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "aspose-barcode-foss"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Pure-Python barcode generator for linear and 2D symbologies (Code 128, Code 39, EAN/UPC, QR Code) with SVG and PNG output."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
license = "MIT"
license-files = ["LICENSE"]
authors = [
    { name = "Aspose Pty Ltd" },
]
maintainers = [
    { name = "Aspose Pty Ltd" },
]
keywords = [
    "barcode",
    "barcode-generator",
    "qr",
    "qr-code",
    "code128",
    "code39",
    "ean13",
    "ean8",
    "upc",
    "upca",
    "upce",
    "svg",
    "png",
]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 4 - Beta",
    "Intended Audience :: Developers",
    "Operating System :: OS Independent",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3 :: Only",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.13",
    "Topic :: Multimedia :: Graphics",
    "Topic :: Software Development :: Libraries :: Python Modules",
    "Typing :: Typed",
]
dependencies = [
    "Pillow>=10.1.0",
]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/aspose-barcode-foss/Aspose.Barcode-FOSS-for-Python"
Repository = "https://github.com/aspose-barcode-foss/Aspose.Barcode-FOSS-for-Python"
Issues = "https://github.com/aspose-barcode-foss/Aspose.Barcode-FOSS-for-Python/issues"

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.0",
    "ruff>=0.15.7",
]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]

[tool.setuptools]
package-dir = {"" = "src"}

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
aspose_barcode_foss = ["py.typed"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 120

[tool.ruff.lint]
# Ruff rules index: https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/rules/
select = [
    # flake8-builtins: prevent shadowing Python builtins.
    "A",
    # flake8-bugbear: catch likely bugs and risky patterns.
    "B",
    # pycodestyle errors: enforce error-level style checks.
    "E",
    # Pyflakes: catch undefined names, unused imports, and similar issues.
    "F",
    # Pylint convention: enforce consistency and maintainability rules.
    "PLC",
    # Pylint error: catch likely runtime and logic errors.
    "PLE",
    # flake8-print: flag print and pprint usage in library code.
    "T20",
    # pyupgrade: prefer modern syntax for the target Python version.
    "UP",
    # pycodestyle warnings: enforce warning-level style checks.
    "W",
]
ignore = [
    # UP006 non-pep585-annotation: allow typing.List-style annotations over list[int].
    # Rule docs: https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/rules/non-pep585-annotation/
    "UP006",
    # UP007 non-pep604-annotation-union: allow typing.Union[X, Y] over X | Y.
    # Rule docs: https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/rules/non-pep604-annotation-union/
    "UP007",
]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
# Example scripts intentionally print their results to stdout.
"examples/*.py" = ["T201"]
